run_biped2d_simulation: run the pybullet biped2d simulation with a programmatic heightfield terrain and biped robot
create_heightfield_terrain: create a programmatic heightfield terrain using random height data and GEOM_HEIGHTFIELD collision shape
create_multibody_grid: create a grid of multi-body objects with sphere and box collision shapes and revolute joints
load_biped_urdf: load the biped2d_pybullet URDF robot model and set position control on all joints
configure_joint_dynamics: configure joint motor control with velocity or position control and set dynamics friction properties
